chunks: Do not neglect to attend to their small matters, confining yourself to their important matters, because your small favours will also be of benefit to them while the important ones are such that they cannot ignore them.

key_terms.يَسْتَغْنُونَ: they become independent / do not need

ai.seo_question: How should a governor balance attention between major and minor affairs of the people?
ai.summary: This directive from Imam Ali’s (as) famous letter to Malik al-Ashtar underscores the Shia political principle of *tawassu'* (approachability), warning against the arrogance of relying solely on major administrative structures while neglecting the subtle needs of the common people. Scholars highlight that this balance ensures the ruler remains connected to the populace's daily realities, fostering trust (*thiqa*) and preventing the alienation that often accompanies bureaucratic detachment.
